run_expand_preset: run expand_preset to replace --preset flag with corresponding argv fragment from presets mapping
test_expand_preset: test expand_preset with --preset sglang_megatron and verify it expands to the correct argv list
refactor_expand_preset: refactor expand_preset to support custom preset names and additional grouping-skip-keys
